title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

title: Executive Vice President, Evidence
description:
**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research, including from Nobel\-winning economists. We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we are making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Deworm the World has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains
* Safe Water Now has saved the lives of over 15,000 children
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You will partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you are looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 Evidence Action was built on the belief that data should drive every decision, from how programs are designed and delivered to how resources are allocated and scaled. Evidence and cost\-effectiveness are central to Evidence Action's comparative advantage; they are what makes us credible and distinctive to government partners and donors alike, and this role will shape how that advantage evolves as we grow.
   

  

 As the Executive Vice President (EVP), Evidence, you will own the strategic growth and transformation of our Monitoring, Learning, and Evaluation teams, our Cost\-Effectiveness arm, and our epidemiology capability at a pivotal organizational moment. You will sit at the intersection of technical rigor, organizational leadership, and external credibility, holding overall accountability for the reliability of the evidence that guides how Evidence Action designs, delivers, and scales its programs. Our recent Dispensers for Safe Water update reflects the transparent, evidence\-first culture this role will help lead.
   

  

 This is a role with two connected mandates under one leader. You will lead the generation and use of evidence throughout the program lifecycle in close collaboration with programs, while maintaining an independence in your assessment of evidence, surfacing uncomfortable findings when necessary. Bringing these together in one senior role reporting directly to the CEO gives evidence a genuine, empowered voice in our decision\-making.
   

  

 In this role, you will sit on Evidence Action's Global Leadership Team (GLT), which sets organizational strategy and direction. This is a pivotal opportunity for an executive who can navigate complexity, inspire high\-performing teams, and translate evidence into action, driving measurable improvements in millions of lives for years to come.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
**Lead a holistic evidence function**
* Oversee the technical and strategic aspects of our evidence teams, ensuring MLE, cost\-effectiveness modeling, and epidemiology connect into a single, coherent picture that informs day\-to\-day program improvement and major decisions, rather than separate streams of analysis
* In collaboration with GLT and program leads, set a cross\-program evidence strategy, defining the questions Evidence Action is answering across its portfolio, matching the right methodological approaches and connecting evidence to both delivery and organizational learning
* Serve as a technical thought partner to teams across Evidence Action, making evidence more readily visible and actionable across the organization, evolving our cost\-effectiveness tooling to enhance visibility into what drives cost\-effectiveness and shortening the feedback loop between realized costs and impact and our projected impact.
* Champion evidence across a program's lifecycle, ensuring we're designing the right evidence generation to feed lessons into scaling decisions and evolving our cost\-effectiveness tools so organizational leaders understand what drives cost\-effectiveness and we can actualize modeled impact
* Institutionalize monitoring and learning (e.g. A/B testing) in programs so performance keeps improving well beyond launch
* Sharpen where Evidence Action's own evidence generation is uniquely valuable versus where other partners are better placed


**Own independent quality assurance**
* Understand how different evidence sources come together across programs to model our impact, and establish and enforce minimum standards for addressing weak evidence, uncertainty, and assumptions in that modeling
* Design and implement the systems that let us review evidence consistently across our portfolio, including program stage gates and structured evidence and programmatic reviews at key decision points
* Own data quality assurance so it is structurally independent from evidence generation, setting methodology standards, commissioning re\-surveys and integrity checks, and surfacing issues early and transparently
* Provide evidence\-based recommendations that inform program scale\-up, ongoing iteration, and wind\-down decisions, holding a strong voice in those decisions while partnering with program and regional leaders who bring essential local context


**Strengthen technical capability and relieve program teams**
* Build internal technical management capacity that benefit our programs
* Lead a multi\-disciplinary function through consolidation and change, building trust across MLE, cost\-effectiveness, and epidemiology teams and bringing our people along through a significant transition
* Identify where AI and modern data tools can strengthen evidence generation and decision\-making at scale


**Represent Evidence Action externally**
* Serve as a senior organizational voice on evidence, engaging donors, the board, and technical partners on our evidence philosophy, methodological choices, and standing evaluation arrangements
* Champion a transparent culture that shares learning; including learning from what does not work, both inside the organization and with the relevant external stakeholders


**Who You Are**
 We are looking for a leader with rigorous technical training who has spent much of their career as a user and steward of evidence in real implementation settings, not primarily as an academic researcher.
   

  

**Essential**
* The courage to act on evidence. You are willing to surface uncomfortable findings to senior leadership and to recommend a change of course when the evidence calls for it
* Technical leadership and management at scale. You have led similar technical teams, upholding quality assurance, in low\- and middle\-income country contexts with a grounding in operational rigor
* Program\-implementation grounding. You pair academic research expertise with genuine operational experience, so you lead as an insider rather than from a distance.
* Technical credibility and range. A PhD or equivalent quantitative expertise that lets you judge the quality of evidence produced, hold teams to a high technical bar, draw on a range of analytical methods, and speak with authority alongside senior technical staff and external partners. Must have a background in cost\-effectiveness or health economics, or the judgment to bring in the right experts
* A strong leader of teams and change. You can conceptualize change management and bring people along, delegate across a large scope, and build trust across teams and cultures


**What this role is not**
* This is not an audit or compliance role. This role is intended to build the systems and structures that reinforce the appropriate generation and application of evidence as programs evolve, so evidence becomes more than just a box we check
* This is not a publication engine. External research is not the primary goal of this work
* This is not a remote or distant role. Field presence and proximity to implementation are design requirements


**Location**
 This role location is flexible, though we have a preference for a country where Evidence Action has an office, with India, Kenya, and Nigeria of particular interest.
   

  

 This role will require approximately 20% travel nationally and internationally as needed.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Evidence Action provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees worldwide.
   

  

* Benefits may differ based on country\-specific regulations


 Benefits include:
   

  

 Comprehensive health insurance
   

  

 Pension/ Retirement savings options
   

  

 Paid leave
   

  

 Avenues for engagement and recognition.
   

  

 Compensation is competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and internal pay scale.
   

  

 Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to representation and inclusion. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.

title: Associate: Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning
description:
**About the Organisation** 




 Collective Good Foundation (CGF) (https://collectivegood.in/about\-us/) is dedicated to developing ecosystems that facilitate sustainable impact. It provides comprehensive program design and implementation solutions to companies and social organisations to address issues across cause areas; enhancing capacities in the development sector and building interventions that can be scaled.
 **Collective Good Foundation currently houses ‘Samyak’, a health initiative set up by a team of professionals with extensive experience in the public health sector in India** 
 .
 



  





 Samyak started off by setting up a pan India, multi\-stakeholder collaborative (Urban Health Initiative (UHI)) 2 years back, to address urban health and nutrition challenges with a focus on urban poor and marginalized populations. UHI brings together urban practitioners, public health experts, donor agencies, government stakeholders and non\-profit organisations to strengthen the urban health system in India, improving the quality of life of people and reducing existing health inequities. Priority areas of UHI includes, among other things, emerging health challenges due to climate change; wherein the Urban Health Initiative is working, under an MoU with the Govt of Uttar Pradesh to address data gaps around climate – health linkages, as well as piloting innovative models to address some of these challenges. UHI is also working in Maharashtra. Partners of Samyak include Janaagraha Centre for Citizenship and Democracy, Samhita, J\-PAL Climate – Health Data Capacity Accelerator, ARTPARK, India Health Fund and ACT for Health.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 CGF is seeking a Data Manager to support the development and management of data systems for Samyak’s urban health initiatives in Maharashtra.
 



 The Data Manager will play a key role in integrating multiple health datasets, developing dashboards, applying advanced analytics, and supporting AI\-enabled data analysis to generate actionable insights for program teams and government stakeholders.
 



 The role requires strong analytical and technical skills, experience working with large health datasets, and the ability to translate complex data into clear visualizations and decision\-support tools.
 



 The position is based in Mumbai and will involve collaboration with program teams, government partners, research teams, and technology partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Data Systems and Management** 



* Manage and maintain data systems supporting urban health programs and decision support platforms.
* Integrate multiple data sources
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity across integrated data systems.



**Data Analysis and Insights** 



* Analyze large and complex health datasets to generate actionable insights for program planning and policy decision making.
* Identify trends, patterns, and gaps in urban health service delivery and health outcomes.
* Support the development of analytical outputs for research studies, program reviews, and policy discussions.



**Dashboard Development and Data Visualization** 



* Design and develop interactive dashboards and data visualization tools for program teams and government stakeholders.
* Build dashboards that support real\-time monitoring, performance tracking, and decision support.
* Ensure dashboards present data in clear, intuitive, and user\-friendly formats.



**AI\-enabled Data Analytics** 



* Explore and apply AI and machine learning tools to create data collection tools, support data analysis, predictive insights, and pattern detection.
* Use AI\-enabled tools to enhance data processing, analytics, and visualization workflows.
* Support the development of data\-driven decision support systems for urban health programs.



**Data Integration and Interoperability, and data governance** 



* Support the integration of datasets from multiple platforms and sources.
* Develop processes for data cleaning, transformation, and harmonization.
* Work with technology partners to ensure interoperability between data systems and analytics platforms.



**Program and Stakeholder Support** 



* Provide analytical support to program teams, research teams, and government stakeholders.
* Support preparation of data summaries, analytical briefs, and visualizations for presentations and reports.
* Build the capacity of program teams to interpret and use data for decision making.



 Qualifications and Experience
 


* Postgraduate degree in Data Science, Public Health, Statistics, Epidemiology, Computer Science, or related fields.
* 3\-6 years of experience in data management, analytics, or data science roles.
* Experience working with health data systems, public health programs, or development sector datasets is preferred.
* Experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources. Strong analytical and statistical skills. Experience with data analysis tools, such as Python, R, Advanced Excel
* Experience developing dashboards using tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Familiarity with AI and machine learning tools for data analysis would be an advantage.



**Language Requirement** 



* Proficiency in Marathi (reading, writing, and speaking) is needed

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
This role will be accountable for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines from source systems. The Data Engineer will ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of data products by integrating raw data from various sources. Key responsibilities include data modeling, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) development, and ensuring data quality and security. This role will be accountable for data coming in from
 **5\-10\+ source systems.** 




  





**Design and Execute** 




 • Partner with data product managers to gather and deliver data pipelines.
 



 • Design ETL solutions including data quality, data security, and data pipeline resiliency.
 



 • Execute ETL solutions including data security, data quality and performance requirements.
 



**Data Extraction, Load and Transformation** 




 • Design, build and implement ELT pipelines to efficiently ingest and transform data from a wide variety of data sources and deliver datasets that meet business requirements.
 



 • Optimize performance for large datasets and data workflows for performance, scalability, and reliability to support business needs.
 



 • Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines leveraging Azure Synapse, PySpark, APIs, and SQL \& performing advanced data cleaning, transformation, and manipulation to ensure high\-quality, and reliable data flows.
 



 • Implement CI/CD processes to streamline and automate data pipelines deployment
 



 • Apply data validation frameworks (Great Expectations, Fabric\-native tools) to maintain accuracy
 



 • Utilize partitioning, indexing, clustering strategies to enhance query performance
 



**Process Improvement, Performance and Cost optimization tuning** 




 • Collaborate with Data Science, AI, and Data product teams to optimize performance and cost effectiveness of their solutions.
 



 • Identify and support the design of internal process improvements, including automating manual processes, optimizing data product delivery, and redesigning solutions for enhanced scalability.
 



 • Implement solution adjustments to improve performance and cost\-effectiveness of data products.
 



**Issue Resolution and Support** 




 • Monitor and troubleshoot the data pipelines proactively, which includes leading the support of data\-related product pipeline issues to resolve data errors.
 



 • Provide expert\-level support and guidance to data teams across the Enterprise.
 



  





**Desired Candidate Profile:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics/Science, or related field
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203\)
* or Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate or related cloud technologies, Fabric IQ/Databricks certifications a plus
* **8\+ years** 
 of data engineering experience.
* Demonstrated ability coding in one or more languages (PySpark preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ownership of production\-grade pipelines.

description:

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 Expedia Global Payments (EGP) is looking for top engineering talent to help drive the development of our payments platform, seamlessly roll out new payments methods, and to continuously raise the bar on our operational excellence and engineering practices. Our services are the nexus of a globally distributed system that spans many organizations. Our roadmap is deep and contains several innovative programs designed to make our services fault tolerant, reduce the cost of payment processing, and improve customer experience. This includes compensating for downstream services that are not in Expedia's control. We are also looking to use cloud computing (AWS) to further solidify our infrastructure. This opportunity presents you with great technical challenges and the ability to have a tremendous business impact. We do this accurately and at scale, processing over $100 billion payments in 60\+ currencies in over 155 countries every year across diverse payment options.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build end\-to\-end backend solutions for Payments, that are scalable, resilient, and performant.
* Own and evolve core payment services and workflows, including payment session lifecycle, payment\-method orchestration, and downstream service integrations.
* Build and enhance backend APIs and service interfaces using Kotlin/Java and modern service frameworks, with strong emphasis on clean contracts, backward compatibility, and operational reliability.
* Develop and support GraphQL, gRPC, and REST\-based integrations that power payment experiences across multiple Expedia Group brands and checkout surfaces.
* Contribute to distributed system design for high\-volume, multi\-tenant, 24x7 payment flows, balancing latency, availability, security, and maintainability.
* Build robust integrations with payment providers, internal platforms, and shared infrastructure while ensuring fault tolerance and graceful degradation.
* Take strong ownership of production systems, including monitoring, alerting, on\-call participation, incident response, and root cause resolution.
* Build and enhance observability through logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and operational playbooks to proactively detect and prevent issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with urgency, minimizing customer, partner, and business impact in high\-transaction environments.
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment safety, and engineering effectiveness through CI/CD, rollback strategies, feature flags, test automation, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, frontend engineers, partner teams, and platform teams to deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable payment capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices across backend design, coding standards, testing, operational excellence, and incident management.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design decisions across the team and broader payments ecosystem.
* Influence cross\-functional delivery and act as a subject matter expert for backend payment architecture, scalability, and service reliability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low\-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS\-backed applications.
* Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale.
* Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep expertise in Java\-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database\-resident logic into application services.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability.
* Demonstrated use of AI\-augmented development or operations (for example, code\-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‑enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes.


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
   

  

**Important notice**
 Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity**
 Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Senior Associate, BIU, IO, Data Engineer** 




  





 Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



 Experience: 5\-8 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented professionals who solve complex client problems and deliver measurable results. Its culture values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity. In 2023, A\&M established its Global Capability Center in India to expand specialized talent, strengthen hybrid onshore\-offshore delivery, accelerate execution, and apply digital and analytics capabilities across the firm. The GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership rather than operating only as a back\-office function. It supports major markets across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, serving industries including Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. The rapidly growing center is now home to more than 1,000 professionals.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As a Senior Associate, Data Engineer within the Business Intelligence Unit, you will own the data foundations that power analytics, reporting, applications, and emerging AI/ML use cases. This hands\-on onsite role combines production engineering, data modelling, platform optimisation, and stakeholder partnership. You will strengthen existing SQL Server pipelines, support the transition to Snowflake and dbt, and embed disciplined engineering practices across the BIU. Working with Analysts, Power Platform Developers, and regional business users, you will turn requirements into reliable, maintainable data solutions. Your work will improve data quality, reporting performance, operational resilience, and the speed at which A\&M converts information into objective business decisions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and improve production ETL scripts, SQL Server processes, and data pipelines, increasing reliability, maintainability, and availability of data used by business\-critical reports and applications.
* Design and maintain business\-ready dimensional and relational data models that provide trusted foundations for analytics, reporting, application development, and future AI/ML solutions.
* Support the enterprise data warehouse transition to Snowflake by implementing scalable transformations, performance improvements, documentation, and deployment practices using dbt where appropriate.
* Embed application lifecycle management across BIU through Git\-based version control, automated testing, controlled releases, and CI/CD processes for database and transformation assets.
* Diagnose and optimise report queries and data workloads, improving response times, scalability, and operational stability for key regional reporting and application use cases.
* Act as the regional technical subject matter expert for BIU data assets, resolving data questions, report issues, permissions, access requirements, and environment setup needs.
* Partner with Analysts, Power Platform Developers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions that deliver measurable insight and operational efficiency.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Five to eight years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, platform engineering, or a comparable technical role, with ownership of production\-grade pipelines and ETL processes.
* Strong SQL and SQL Server expertise, including query optimisation, relational design, troubleshooting, SQL Server Agent jobs, and production support for business\-critical reporting or application data.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse, including warehouse performance optimisation, data modelling, and engineering practices for scalable analytical workloads.
* Practical experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, covering model development, testing, documentation, lineage, and repeatable deployment of data assets.
* Experience using Git, CI/CD, version\-controlled database objects, and controlled deployment processes within an application lifecycle management framework.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory and the broader Azure data ecosystem, including permissions, access management, and data setup supporting analytics and application development.
* Working knowledge of Python or a similar scripting language for data transformation, automation, operational support, and process improvement.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, documentation standards, lineage, and controls that improve trust, discoverability, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Experience enabling data products or platforms for Power Platform applications, business intelligence solutions, and emerging artificial intelligence or machine learning use cases.
* Exposure to consulting, professional services, or multi\-region stakeholder environments where technical teams must respond quickly to changing business priorities.



  





**What You'll Bring** 




 You bring a strong production mindset and the judgement to distinguish between a quick fix and an engineering solution that will remain reliable at scale. You have built, maintained, and improved data pipelines in live environments, and you are comfortable investigating failures, optimising SQL, and supporting business\-critical data assets. You can work confidently across SQL Server and cloud data warehouse environments, with hands\-on experience in Snowflake, data modelling, and preferably dbt. You understand why Git, testing, CI/CD, documentation, permissions, and repeatable deployments matter, and you apply those practices pragmatically rather than as process for its own sake. You communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, explain trade\-offs, and provide hands\-on support when regional users need answers. You work independently while collaborating closely with analysts, application developers, and business partners. Most importantly, you are curious, detail\-oriented, and willing to challenge the status quo when a better, more robust way of delivering data can improve decision\-making and operational outcomes.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 



* Shape the data architecture behind a rapidly growing global consulting capability center, with direct influence on analytics, applications, operational efficiency, and emerging AI/ML initiatives.
* Work alongside experienced consultants, analysts, developers, and business leaders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC on high\-impact, cross\-functional problems.
* Grow through formal training, on\-the\-job learning, continuous performance development, and a meritocratic culture that rewards ownership, contribution, and measurable impact.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment grounded in Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, with meaningful opportunities to improve how work is delivered.
* Structured performance development, technical training, and on\-the\-job learning that support continuous skill development and long\-term career progression.
* Well\-being benefits and personal resources designed to support your professional growth and personal journey while working with a growing global team.

title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:** 
**2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (Formal/Final Formal)
* L8\+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible


**Grade/Level:** 
**10**

title: Senior Analyst, AFR
description:
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
   

  

 The role is within the AXA XL Reinsurance Portfolio Analytics team. Portfolio Analytics operates as part of a global reinsurance network, working with underwriters, actuaries and business heads across multiple regions, with a culture of collaboration and participation across a range of high\-profile projects. The team seeks to make full use of available data sources to better manage reinsurance portfolios and enhance the reinsurance operation’s profitability. The team conceptualizes, designs and develops innovative management information for underwriters, actuaries and senior management. The team’s other objectives include creating high\-end analytical solutions and automating manual processes using the latest technologies.
   

  

**What You’ll Be DOING**
 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

* Create and run standard reports whilst looking to automate their generation and distribution. Review management information created by other people across the Reinsurance segment.
* Create new innovative management information using Excel, Qlik Sense, VBA and / or PowerBI.
* Support product management within the reinsurance operations. Work with people from across the reinsurance segment to determine how to best measure risk and profitability for various lines of business and how to construct and manage portfolios accordingly.
* Responsibility for checking that the reinsurance data is correct. Setting up a process for regular data checks, investigating any potential issues and taking any appropriate actions.
* Take ownership of mappings, making sure any new mapping required is added in a timely manner.
* Understand/explain data and assist the reinsurance community with any questions including how to access required data, definitions and the source of data.
* To assist with complex data needs, sourcing the appropriate data from multiple reinsurance systems.
* Test any new developments to the Reinsurance Analytics project before they are released.
* To be involved in deciding the direction of any specifying new development to the Reinsurance Analytics project.
* Provide training and support on the Reinsurance Analytics tools for a broad user base across multiple regions and functions – including underwriting, actuarial and senior management.


 You will report to the Senior Lead, Pricing Data \& Reporting.
   

  

**What You Will BRING**
 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
* University Graduate with qualification B.E/B.Tech(CS/IT).
* Excellent analytical, research and problem\-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of SQL.
* Desirable skill but not mandatory Knowledge of Python programming language.


**Desired Skills And Abilities**
* Outstanding computer application skills, specifically Excel and experience using any of the following BI applications is desirable e.g. Qlik Sense, Qlik View, PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.
* Ability to multi\-task and work effectively in a fast\-paced team environment.
* Exposure to Data Analytics / Machine Learning preferred.
* Keen attention to detail.
* Effective oral and written communication skills.


**Who WE Are**
 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
   

  

 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
   

  

 Learn more at axaxl.com
   

  

**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*
* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter


 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

**Total Rewards**
 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
   

  

**Our Pillars**
* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far\-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.


 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Specialist, Investment Data Management
description:
We are looking for a
 **Specialist, Investment Data Management** 
 to join our Investment Data \& Analytics team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a dynamic strategic team whose scope and importance continue to grow. The IDA Department, within CCLFG’s Investment Operations Group, supports industry standards and customized analytics in addition to data. We support pre\-trade analysis, modeling, trading, compliance, as well as post\-trade performance, attribution, client reporting, sales reporting, and custom analytics. The Investment Data Management (IDM) Team, part of the Investment Data and Analytics (IDA) group resides within the middle office and is responsible for managing data centric processes and data quality that supports the investment management business. The team ensures that daily and historical data is accurate, data delivery processes are successful, and comply with overall data governance. IDM is a key thought\-leader in driving data management maturity at Connor, Clark \& Lunn Financial Group (CCLFG). CCLFG manages a wide range of global assets and heavily relies on the output of the IDM for a variety of functions from the front office to back office. We place a high value on maintaining an entrepreneurial spirit and creating a culture where each of us has opportunities to succeed. We are a solution orientated and collaborative team seeking like\-minded individuals who thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment.
   

  

**Work Timings** 
 : AM Shift (6:30 AM – 3:30 PM) or PM Shift (1:30 PM – 10:30 PM)
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Work at the intersection of business operations and systems technology to create, manage, and maintain high‑quality investment data across a wide range of global security types.
* Own and oversee data processes, proactively investigating and resolving data issues while supporting continuous process improvement and ad‑hoc problem solving
* Act as a process owner collaborating with global investment managers, traders, portfolio managers, compliance, technology, and middle‑/back‑office teams
* Leverage strong analytical skills and attention to detail to work with databases and business applications, write business requirements, and support testing and implementation of system enhancement
* Maintain and validate fixed\-income, equity and derivatives reference and pricing data across multiple systems and databases with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
* Prioritize, monitor, and manage scheduled processes, ad\-hoc requests, and projects in collaboration with multiple business partners to support analytic, investing, and portfolio management functions
* Provide key pre\-modeling data signoffs for investment affiliates
* Analyze exception reports and follow\-up to ensure timely resolution
* Identify, develop, and implement scalable improvements to support ever\-changing requirements
* Support process improvements to increase efficiency, mitigate risk, and increase the level of service provided to stakeholders
* Support continuous data quality improvements (policy, procedures, processes, audits)
* Support the Seniors and Manager on a variety of ad hoc tasks and digital transformation projects.


**What You Bring**
* Education – You have a degree in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field. Completion or enrollment in a relevant designation, such as the CFA or FRM, is an asset
* Industry Knowledge – 1\-3 years of experience in the investment management industry with exposure to securities data, data quality and process management. Hands\-on experience working with Bloomberg, FTSE, ICE Bond Edge, Charles River and related financial tools, platforms is an asset.
* Problem Solver – You possess an analytical mindset and able to break down complex processes into components to logically deduce the root cause of issues
* Collaborative – You have a collaborative spirit that helps you to work well with others and you communicate effectively
* Self\-Motivated – You have a passion for advancing the quality, scale, and efficiency of data processes and can take ownership of multiple processes with keen attention to detail
* Continuous Process Improvement Mindset – You constantly take a critical eye to processes with the goal of finding improvement opportunities and bring an ability to manage multiple projects
* Technical / Database Knowledge – You can perform data analysis using intermediate Excel skills and basic SQL knowledge to query and interpret complex datasets effectively.


 For a closer look at how you can build your career with us, we invite you to explore cclgroup.com.
   

  

 CC\&L Financial Group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation or expression, disability, or age. We are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment and selection process. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact talentacqusition@cclgroup.com if you require accommodation.
   

  

 Your application will be reviewed by a member of the hiring team \- AI is not used in the screening, assessment or selection of applications at this time.

title: Anaplan Model Builder
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 As an Anaplan Model Builder, you are primarily responsible for the successful delivery of Anaplan solutions.
 



 You will be required to model sophisticated business problems, collaborate to search for hard\-to\-find answers, and effectively uncover insights for our Business Partners. Strong analytics skills, resourcefulness, and the capacity to adapt to a scaling organization will help you be successful. Being able to operate independently and lead in a dynamic environment is key to this role.
 



**You will:** 



* Lead Anaplan model development and serve as architectural SME for large\-scale connected planning solutions
* Translate existing spreadsheets and business problems into sophisticated Anaplan multi\-dimensional models
* Modify existing models as part of a connected solution, optimization, or to incorporate new functionality
* Provide significant feedback and progress updates promptly to the Business Partner and team
* Set up standard processes and documentation for Anaplan models
* Participate in data integration and migration solutions
* Partner on all aspects of identifying, evaluating, and communicating key insights that tell the story behind the numbers, our employee experience, and key drivers
* Enjoy Being part of a team and working in an “all hands on deck” environment, shifting between different types of tasks, working with several partners, and being passionate about storytelling.
* Ability to investigate the root cause of data and reporting issues



**Your Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in business (Finance, Operations, Accounting, etc.) or highly technical field (Engineering, mathematics, data analytics, etc.)
* Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning
* 2\+ years of Anaplan model\-building experience with at least 1 large and complex ground\-up build

 KPMG is a global network of professional firms providing Audit, Tax and Advisory services. We operate in 156 countries and have 152,000 people working in member firms around the world.
 



 KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993\. Our professionals leverage the global network of firms, providing detailed knowledge of local laws, regulations, markets and competition. KPMG in India provide services to over 4,500 international and national clients, in India. KPMG has offices across India in Delhi, Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, Bangalore, Kochi, Hyderabad and Kolkata. The Indian firm has access to more than 7,000 Indian and expatriate professionals, many of whom are internationally trained. We strive to provide rapid, performance\-based, industry\-focused and technology\-enabled services, which reflect a shared knowledge of global and local industries and our experience of the Indian business environment.
 



 KPMG Advisory professionals provide advice and assistance to enable companies, intermediaries and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance, and create value. KPMG firms provide a wide range of Risk Consulting, Management Consulting and Transactions \& Restructuring services that can help clients respond to immediate needs as well as put in place the strategies for the longer term.
 



 With increasing regulatory requirements, the need for greater transparency in operations, and disclosure norms, stakeholders require assurance beyond the traditional critique of numbers. Hence assurance is being increasingly required on industry issues, business risks and key business processes. The Governance, Risk \& Compliance Services practice assists companies and public sector bodies to mitigate risk, improve performance and create value.
 



  





 We assist our clients to effectively manage business and process risks by providing a full spectrum of corporate governance, risk management, and Compliance Services. These services are tailored to meet client’s individual needs, and provide effective support to management in meeting the challenges and opportunities presented by today's complex business environment.
 



  





 Our professionals provide the experience to help companies stay on track and deal with risks that could unhinge their business survival. Our services enable clients to effectively co\-ordinate their key growth, quality and operational challenges and working in partnership with us, clients have the benefits of KPMG's experienced, objective, and industry\-grounded viewpoints.
 



  





  





 Position Title
 



**Consultant / Senior Consultant – Credit Risk Model Development \& Validation** 




 Location \- Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
 



  





 Experience
 **2–7 Years** 




  





**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking talented professionals with expertise in
 **Credit Risk Model Development and Validation** 
 to join our growing Risk Management practice. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in developing, validating, monitoring, and enhancing credit risk models across retail and wholesale portfolios.
 



 The role requires strong quantitative, analytical, and programming skills along with a solid understanding of regulatory guidelines such as
 **Basel, RBI, IFRS 9, and IRB frameworks** 
 .
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Model Development
 


* Develop and enhance credit risk models including:
* Probability of Default (PD)
* Loss Given Default (LGD)
* Exposure at Default (EAD)
* IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models
* Application, Behavioral, and Collection Scorecards
* Stress Testing Models
* Conduct data analysis, segmentation, feature engineering, and model calibration.
* Implement statistical and machine learning methodologies for risk assessment.



  





 Model Validation
 


* Perform independent validation of risk models and scorecards.
* Assess model methodology, assumptions, performance, and regulatory compliance.
* Conduct discrimination, calibration, stability, sensitivity, and back\-testing exercises.
* Prepare validation reports and present findings to stakeholders and governance committees.



  





 Regulatory \& Risk Management
 


* Support Basel, RBI, IFRS 9, and Internal Ratings\-Based (IRB) framework requirements.
* Participate in model governance, model risk management, and remediation activities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory expectations.



  





 Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Analyze large datasets to identify portfolio trends and risk drivers.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and monitoring frameworks.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to business and risk stakeholders.



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 Domain Expertise
 


* Experience in:
* Credit Risk Model Development
* Credit Risk Model Validation

* IFRS 9 Modeling \& Validation

 Technical Skills

* Python
* SAS
* R
* SQL

* Logistic Regression
* Linear Regression
* Time Series Analysis
* Survival Analysis
* Machine Learning Techniques
* Experience handling large\-scale banking and financial datasets.



  





 Regulatory Knowledge
 


* Strong understanding of:
* RBI Regulations
* Basel II / Basel III
* IFRS 9
* IRB Approaches
* Model Governance Frameworks



  





 Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with banks, NBFCs, fintechs, consulting firms, or financial institutions.



  





 Key Competencies
